correctness.rationale: For H_n=K_{n,n} minus matching, n>=5, explicit closed-neighborhood traces show minimum identifying codes exactly one-hole transversals with both shores having >=2 selections, size n−1. For n=5 all 30 frozen; n=6 preserve a 3-index color set giving 20 K3,3; for n>=7 three-slide recolor of occupied position at fixed hole and two-slide hole transfer after p,q>=3 prove connected. Independently reconstructed ternary state slide graph and BFS for n=5..8: correct components and edge counts; finite checks complement explicit all-n moves.
